headline: B2B Campaign Strategy | Marketing Systems | Funnel Analytics
headline_rationale: AssetWatch needs integrated demand campaigns, system execution and credible measurement across marketing and sales. Emphasize supported B2B coordination, CRM integration, attribution and experimentation without inventing industrial SaaS pipeline results.
summary: B2B and digital marketing practitioner combining campaign planning with hands-on systems and analytics. Directed execution and reporting across marketing, sales, operations, finance, IT and product teams, and built reporting across more than ten marketing channels with Python, SQL and Funnel.io. Installed and integrated Go High Level with ServiceTitan, Power BI and internal systems while training employees. Brings client strategy, funnel experimentation and scalable account processes to aligning campaign execution with business goals.
factual_review: Read exact AssetWatch B2B Growth Marketing Manager posting. Current master supports E060/E065/E066/E009/E076/E082 plus Any Hour CRM integrations/training. HubSpot/Salesforce are supported tools, not proof of specific HubSpot nurture or Salesforce RevOps architecture projects. No invented SaaS pipeline metrics or compliance specialty.
tools_rationale: Prioritize supported CRM, tracking, integrations and reporting tools relevant to campaign operations.
